explanations.WITHIN_TOLERANCE: Received quantity is within the configured over-receipt tolerance.
explanations.PARTIAL_STOCK_AVAILABLE: Available stock covered part of the request; partial reservation was selected.
explanations.INSUFFICIENT_AVAILABLE: Insufficient available stock; remaining units were placed on backorder.
explanations.NEGATIVE_ALLOWED_FOR_STORE: Store negative-stock policy allowed posting below zero.
explanations.SERIAL_COUNT_MATCHED: Serialized unit count matched the order line tolerance.
explanations.SERIALIZED_NEGATIVE_FORBIDDEN: Serialized products cannot enter a negative stock balance.
explanations.FULL_RESERVATION_OK: Full requested quantity was reserved from available stock.
explanations.OVER_RECEIPT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Receipt quantity exceeded the maximum over-receipt tolerance and was blocked.
explanations.RESERVATION_PARTIAL_ALLOWED: Partial reservation is allowed when available stock is short.
explanations.RESERVATION_BACKORDER_ALLOWED: Backorder is allowed when available stock is short.
explanations.NEGATIVE_STOCK_ALLOWED: Negative stock balance is allowed by policy.
explanations.OVER_RECEIPT_EXCEEDS_TOLERANCE: Received quantity exceeds the configured over-receipt tolerance.
